# Inphinit Framework Documentation

> Inphinit is a lightweight, high-performance PHP micro-framework designed to leverage native PHP functions and use a concise structure for processing route callbacks, consuming minimal server resources.

## Core

- [Getting Started](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/): System requirements, installation via Composer or Git, and local development server setup.
- [Application Structure](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/structure.html): Detailed overview of the directory layout and system folders.
- [Configurations](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/configurations.html): Environment settings, `.env` management, and application configuration files.
- [Views](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/views.html): Rendering views, passing variables, and template management.

## Web Servers

- [Apache Configuration](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/web-servers/apache.html): Web server setup guides for Apache.
- [IIS Configuration](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/web-servers/iis.html): Web server setup guides for IIS.
- [IIS Express Configuration](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/web-servers/iis-express.html): Web server setup guides for IIS Express.
- [Nginx Configuration](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/web-servers/nginx.html): Web server setup guides for Nginx.
- [Caddy and FrankenPHP Configuration](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/web-servers/caddy-frankenphp.html): Web server setup guides for Caddy and FrankenPHP.

## Routes & Controllers

- [Routing System](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/routing/): Basic route creation, closure routes, and URL pattern matching.
- [Controllers](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/controllers.html): Controller structure, namespace handling, and execution flow.
- [Implicit Routes with Controllers](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/routing/implicit-route-controllers.html): Implicit route binding using controllers.
- [RESTful resource routing with Controllers](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/routing/resource.html): RESTful resource routing using Controllers.

## Features

- [Checkup Utility](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/checkup.html): Diagnostic tools for environment readiness and system checks.
- [Console Commands](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/console-commands.html): CLI runner (`./run`) utility commands and development tools.
- [Debugging](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/debugging.html): Debugging tools, error logging, and development mode options.
- [Error Pages](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/error-pages.html): Handling 404, 500, and custom HTTP exception responses.
- [Events](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/events.html): Event listeners, triggers, and lifecycle hooks.
- [Maintenance Mode](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/maintenance.html): Enabling and customizing maintenance mode pages.
- [Session Management](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/session.html): Managing HTTP sessions and flash data.

## HTTP Handling

- [HTTP Request](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/http/request.html): Reading request data, headers, query parameters, and uploaded files.
- [HTTP Response](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/http/response.html): Returning HTTP responses, setting status codes, headers, and redirects.
- [HTTP Response Codes](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/http/response-codes.html): Provides a list of constants for common HTTP response status codes.
- [Content Negotiation](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/http/content-negotiation.html): Handling content types (expressed as MIME types), Accept headers, and multi-format outputs.

## DOM, XML, and HTML

- [Handling DOM, XML, and HTML](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/dom/): Parsing HTML and XML documents, with support for extracting namespaces.
- [CSS selectors in PHP](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/dom/css-selector.html): Using CSS selectors with DOM in PHP, which can also be useful for developing a crawler.
- [DOM with Arrays](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/dom/dom-with-arrays.html): Converting HTML and XML to `Array`, and `Array` to HTML or XML.
- [DOM errors](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/dom/errors.html): Detecting errors in HTML and XML documents.

## Utilities

- [Common Utilities](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/utilities/): Utilities for arrays and strings, and alternatives for backward compatibility with older PHP versions.
- [URL Utility](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/utilities/url.html): Guide to using the URL utility, including how to parse, slugify, standardize, and sort a URL.
- [Version Utility](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/utilities/version.html): Guide to using the version string utility, including how to parse, modify, and compare two version strings.

## Production

- [Sendfile](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/production/sendfile.html): Efficiently serving files in production using sendfile support.

## Packages

- [Inphinit Proxy](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/packages/inphinit-proxy.html): Standalone PHP proxy library for overcoming CORS constraints in client-side tools like html2canvas.

## Experimental

- [Experimental CSV & TSV Reader](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/experimental/csv-tsv-reader.html): Parsing and reading CSV and TSV files, with support for converting to JSON, XML, and HTML.
- [Experimental HTTP resources](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/experimental/http-resources.html): New experimental features specifically for managing HTTP.
- [Experimental Cookie Jar](https://inphinit.github.io/en/docs/experimental/http-cookies.html): Managing HTTP cookies in separate groups, as if they were cookie jars.
